name: Start a session path: /admin to /admin/new (look only)
limitations: Create is never clicked; no form saved

steps.js: (()=>{const k='audit_'+"\"measure admin\""; sessionStorage.setItem(k, JSON.stringify({sessions: document.querySelectorAll('main ul li').length, newBtn: [...document.querySelectorAll('a')].filter(a=>a.textContent.trim()==='New session').map(a=>a.getBoundingClientRect().toJSON()), h: document.documentElement.scrollHeight})); return 'ok'})()
steps.label: measure admin

steps.js: (()=>{const k='audit_'+"\"measure new\""; sessionStorage.setItem(k, JSON.stringify({h: document.documentElement.scrollHeight, sum: document.querySelector('details summary')?.getBoundingClientRect().toJSON(), text: document.querySelector('main').innerText.slice(0,400)})); return 'ok'})()
steps.label: measure new

steps.text: Or fill in the form yourself

steps.js: (()=>{const k='audit_'+"\"measure form\""; sessionStorage.setItem(k, JSON.stringify({h: document.documentElement.scrollHeight, btns: [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].map(b=>[b.textContent.trim(), Math.round(b.getBoundingClientRect().top)])})); return 'ok'})()
steps.label: measure form

steps.value: What should we change about the park?

steps.js: (()=>{const k='audit_'+"\"slug after typing spaces and caps\""; sessionStorage.setItem(k, document.querySelector('#slug').value); return 'ok'})()
steps.label: slug after typing spaces and caps
